title: Male beauty: NIQ identifies growth opportunities beyond men's products
summary: Men are paying increasing attention to their appearance and ageing, but brands specifically targeting male consumers are not necessarily benefiting most from this shift. According to a new report from market research firm NielsenIQ, growth opportunities may lie in a broader approach to beauty and skincare, beyond traditional gender-based positioning.
